subject: Ousmane Dembele
title: Dembele's Dortmund skip and the 105m fee

lines.vo: Dembele missed Dortmund training. Barcelona paid a 105 million base fee.
lines.footage: Dembele Borussia Dortmund archive, neutral shot

lines.vo: He scored a World Cup hat-trick against Norway by the thirty-second minute. Early start, for once.
lines.footage: France Norway World Cup 2026 highlights, Dembele goals

lines.vo: Then came the Ballon d'Or: seventh, behind Kane, Mbappe and Yamal. Still comfortably ahead of eighth.
In the Champions League final, he scored the equalising penalty against Arsenal. PSG won four-three on penalties.
lines.footage: Champions League final 2026 highlights, PSG v Arsenal

lines.vo: Barcelona later sold him for 50.4 million. Great business, Barca.

facts_used: Dortmund 2017: sanctioned for missing training without a valid excuse; later Barcelona move (https://fr.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ousmane_Demb%C3%A9l%C3%A9)
Barcelona signing for a 105m base fee in 2017; sold to PSG in 2023 for 50.4m (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ousmane_Demb%C3%A9l%C3%A9)
World Cup 2026 hat-trick vs Norway, goals at 7', 20' and 32' (https://www.espn.com/soccer/story/_/id/49189907/ousmane-dembele-first-half-hat-trick-france)
Seventh at the 2026 Ballon d'Or, behind Kane, Mbappe and Yamal (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2026_Ballon_d%27Or)
Equalising penalty in the 2026 Champions League final, 1-1 with Arsenal; PSG won 4-3 on penalties (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ousmane_Demb%C3%A9l%C3%A9)
notes: The Dortmund item is a training sanction, not a strike; the French page is the source for that wording. The 105m is the base fee, with reported add-ons (about 40m) left out. 'Great business, Barca' is a light roast of a transfer, not of a person. Fines, injury history, family, religion and the 2021 hotel incident are excluded. The hat-trick minutes come from ESPN. after_line counts from 1. Punch-up pass: 'early start, for once' is a light tease of the documented training sanction, not a claim about habits. 'Great business, Barca' roasts the transfer, not a person. Transfer fee remains the base fee only.
